next_gate: Wave87: bind one exact multi-witness commit-set identity before fan-out and test safe completion of a partial witness fan-out only when advanced witnesses share that exact commit-set and lagging witnesses are exactly at its predecessor. Any competing commit-set must remain HOLD; no voting/newest-wins.
positive_result: One surviving newer valid witness exposes a rollback of the primary plus the other witnesses, while no single witness is promoted to authority. Exact unanimous one-epoch-ahead witnesses can recover a pointer move after all witness appends completed.
preserved_counterexample: If the primary and every configured software witness are rolled back together to one mutually consistent old snapshot, this software-only contract cannot prove the lost future.
